status: Primary-source research and local source audit; no rendering experiment

sources.title: Adaptively Sampled Distance Fields: A General Representation of Shape for Computer Graphics
sources.authors: Sarah F. Frisken, Ronald N. Perry, Alyn P. Rockwood, Thouis R. Jones
sources.access: Read publisher abstract and full text of the eight-page MERL PDF including cover pages.
sections: 4.1: precise carving and reconstructed-field ray casting
sources.supports: Sampling detail, interpolation, gradients and root solving are distinct design choices.
sources.cubey_inference: Test whether the current cache can reconstruct an adequate surface before designing another hierarchy. Finite sampled error tests alone are not universal certificates.
sources.limits: No new ADF builder is proposed for the first loop; historical image quality and timing do not predict Cubey results.

sources.title: Ray Tracing of Signed Distance Function Grids
sources.authors: Herman Hansson-Soderlund, Alex Evans, Tomas Akenine-Moller
sources.access: Read the authors' NVIDIA research abstract. Journal landing page returned no text. Full PDF retrieval failed because its 49,723,521-byte response exceeded the web reader limit; no detailed algorithm inspection is claimed.
sources.supports: Compares voxel traversal/intersection combinations and describes trilinear surface intersections and continuous normals.
sources.cubey_inference: Treat faithful cached-surface intersection as separate from exact authored-source evaluation.
sources.limits: No cubic solver, BVH or hardware ray-tracing port selected. Full paper/code inspection is a prerequisite if that mechanism is chosen.

sources.title: Mesh Distance Fields
sources.access: Read official documentation, particularly Quality and Global Distance Field. The retrieved page identifies Unreal Engine 5.8; engine-specific limits are not Cubey limits.
sources.supports: Resolution affects corner and thin-surface fidelity and storage cost.
sources.cubey_inference: Measure actual visible feature loss separately from normal or shading improvement.
sources.limits: Offline mesh generation and engine-specific clipmaps are not qualified for Cubey's editable CSG.

sources.title: Distance Field Soft Shadows
sources.access: Read official documentation, especially Mesh Distance Field Quality and its reconstruction/temporal-support discussion.
sources.supports: Shadow evaluation can use reduced resolution with depth-aware reconstruction and temporal antialiasing, with remaining artifacts.
sources.cubey_inference: Shadow fidelity is a separate research axis, with a reconstruction dependency.
sources.limits: Cubey has not qualified the corresponding temporal resolve. Do not transplant engine timings or claim cheaper shadows repair primary geometry.

limits: No new native benchmark or implementation in this planning pass.
Earlier sampled and latest analytical timings have different executable/run identities.
Quality budgets are proposed measurement bands, not accepted defaults.
Approximation policies, numerical validity, history correctness and human visual acceptance are distinct gates.
